title: KOBI Snake simulation replay
description: A recorded two-player round (docs/sprints/sprint-02-core-simulation.md KS-02-06). Every file in tests/sim/replays/ except this schema itself is loaded and asserted by tests/sim/replay.test.js. See tests/sim/replays/README.md for how a file becomes a passing test.

seed.description: Passed straight to RoundSimulation/runRound as the round seed (src/core/rng.js). Only the low 32 bits are used.

settingsOverrides.description: Optional. Deep-merged onto the shipping SETTINGS via src/core/settings.js's withOverrides() before the round runs. Omit (or use {}) to run with the shipping defaults.

inputs.description: The recorded input log, in any order (replay.test.js/harness.js sort by tick before applying). Each entry's t is simulated seconds from round start and is resolved to an exact tick with Math.round(t * settings.simHz) before it is applied - never applied at a wall-clock time - because an input delivered at a frame boundary can land on a different tick under a different dt, and a replay must reproduce one specific tick, not one specific instant (tests/sim/determinism.test.js documents why). An empty array is a legal, and useful, replay: it reproduces the round with nobody touching a key.

t.description: Simulated seconds since round start. Resolved to a tick with Math.round(t * settings.simHz).

player.description: Matches the player id RoundSimulation assigns from the bots/players list order - p1 first, p2 second.

dir.description: One of src/core/grid.js's DIRECTIONS, by name. A direction that reverses the snake's current heading, or repeats it, is legal to record here but is silently dropped by Snake.queueDirection when applied (DESIGN-DECISIONS §2.2), exactly as a real keypress would be.

expectedEvents.description: The exact event log runRound({ seed, bots, settings, inputLog: inputs }).events must equal, in order. Each element is one simulation event as emitted by src/core/events.js: at minimum { type, tick, t, ...payload }.
